study_goals.official_research_questions: MISSING - the repository documents study goals but no numbered thesis research questions; the goals below are quoted from the design document and must be replaced or confirmed by the author's official research questions

goals.text: Measure whether and how analysis feedback improves LLM-generated parallel code (initial generation followed by bounded repair iterations).

Which kind of feedback helps: static analysis (static_feedback) vs. ParEval tests + dynamic analysis (test_feedback) vs. all sources (combined_feedback), as an ablation over three loop variants with identical starting points.
Held-out generalisation / overfitting: whether rising ParEval pass rates over iterations are matched by enhanced (held-out) pass rates.

Per variant and iteration: blocking findings per tool/class, ParEval pass rate, enhanced pass rate, stop-reason distribution, iterations-to-clean, cost; per problem type; 'statically clean but incorrect' rate of static_feedback.

documented_deviations: repair-loop-design.md states an iteration budget of 3; the frozen methodology (pilot_002_methodology_freeze.json repair.max_iterations, every run contract) executed at most 2 repair iterations - the analysis uses the frozen value 2.

observation_units.base_cell: one (block, model, benchmark, execution_model) prompt cell with exactly one initial generation (num_samples_per_prompt = 1); identified by (block, model_id, sample_id)
observation_units.artifact: one assembled program (base cell at iteration 0 or a repair candidate at iteration >= 1); identified by (block, model_id, source_run, sample_id)
observation_units.trajectory: the repair trajectory of one base cell under one variant: iterations 0..final_iteration, terminal status from the loop's own state ledger
observation_units.enhanced_pair: one (artifact, held-out spec) execution; NOT an independent observation
observation_units.benchmark: the resampling cluster: every artifact of a benchmark (all models, execution models, variants, iterations) shares its prompt family and oracle

BASE.definition: the 1,980 base cells (pilot_002 396 + full_ext_001 1,584), iteration-0 artifacts

STEP.definition: for variant v and step k in {0,1,2}: per base cell the artifact of iteration min(k, final_iteration) of its v trajectory (last artifact carried forward); STEP[v][0] == BASE
STEP.use: quality after iteration k; identical cohort for every v and k

FINAL.definition: for variant v: per base cell the artifact of the trajectory's terminal iteration (== STEP[v][2]); for trajectories terminal at iteration 0 the final artifact IS the base artifact
FINAL.use: repair outcome per strategy on the identical 1,980-cell cohort

GENERATED.use: diagnostic only; never mixed with FINAL or STEP rates

ENH_PAIRS.definition: the enhanced pairs of the artifacts of a population; VALID pairs = status not in GATED

rules: FINAL and STEP are selected exclusively from the loop's own terminal state ledger (state.jsonl, continued loops: recovery_001 rows overlaid by the successor rows); no held-out (enhanced) or post-hoc evidence takes part in the selection
terminal statuses are trajectory facts, not success metrics: stopped_clean and stopped_tests_pass are never counted as successful repairs
BASE, STEP and FINAL rates of different variants use the identical base-cell cohort; GENERATED/REPAIR_CANDIDATES rates are reported separately and labelled diagnostic

strata.block_rule: pilot (pilot_002, 12 benchmarks) and full_ext (full_ext_001 + recovery 001..004 + phase 2, 48 benchmarks) are disjoint benchmark sets; every table reports both blocks; 'composite' pools them under the frozen composite population (1,980 cells) and is always reported next to the blocks; pilot numbers carry the pilot label
strata.model_id: the 11 models (no ranking, no aggregate score)
strata.family: problem type of the benchmark (12 families; pilot 1 + full_ext 4 benchmarks per family)

tool_state_rules: COMPLETED: the tool finished its analysis; it does NOT imply defect-free code
PARTIAL: an incomplete analysis; absence of findings under PARTIAL is NOT 'clean'
TIMEOUT and TOOL_ERROR are analysis gaps, never confirmed program defects
NOT_ANALYZED: the tool ran but did not analyze the model code (e.g. frontend abort); an analysis gap
NOT_APPLICABLE: the tool does not apply to the execution model (recorded entry)

ABSENT_INAPPLICABLE: no entry for a tool that does not apply to the artifact's execution model (14 historical pilot records); reported separately, treated like NOT_APPLICABLE for applicability, never as a gap
an ABSENT entry for an APPLICABLE tool is a data error (the pipeline fails closed)
correctness_rules: pass = verdict 'pass' (ParEval tests, all launch grid points)
baseline_incompatible (oracle-side, execution contract A1b) is excluded from every correctness denominator and reported separately (0 observed in the frozen data; the rule is kept)
enhanced_rules: gated pairs (oracle-side) are never counted against a model; they are documented in full (E4)
build_failed, crash, timeout, runtime_error and fail are model outcomes of valid pairs (end-to-end evaluation)

gates are spec-level: within one (block, benchmark, spec, execution_model) every artifact carries the same gate decision (verified: 48 gated groups, 0 mixed) - paired comparisons therefore use identical valid spec sets; a mixed group fails the pipeline

finding_rules.reported_blocking: a recorded finding with blocking == true and low_confidence == false
finding_rules.low_confidence: a recorded finding with low_confidence == true (validation-derived low precision, rendered as a hint in the loop; counted separately, never as a confirmed defect)
finding_rules.non_blocking: a recorded finding with blocking == false
finding_rules.compile_error: a blocking finding of the compiler tool (build precondition, reported separately from analysis findings)
finding_rules.families: thesis.evaluation.finding_classes.classify_finding(tool, check_id, message) -> memory, uninitialized, null_deref, arithmetic, race, deadlock, mpi_usage, api_misuse, build, other
finding_rules.no_cross_tool_sum: findings of different tools are never added into one defect count; tables report per tool; candidate-level 'any blocking finding' indicators are unions over tools and are labelled as such
finding_rules.analysis_verdict_three_state: per stage (static excluding the compiler, dynamic): DIRTY = >= 1 reported blocking finding from any applicable tool; CLEAN_COMPLETE = no reported blocking finding and every applicable tool COMPLETED; NO_FINDING_INCOMPLETE = no reported blocking finding and >= 1 applicable tool in an analysis gap state

metrics.name: generation_success
metrics.meaning: the provider returned a successful generation
metrics.missingness: a missing generation record fails the pipeline
metrics.limits: says nothing about code quality

metrics.name: assembly_success
metrics.meaning: the answer was assembled into a compilable translation-unit file
metrics.limits: assembly applies deterministic cleaning (Q04)

metrics.name: generation_truncated
metrics.meaning: the generation hit the output limit

metrics.name: cleaning_intervention
metrics.meaning: the pipeline changed the raw answer before measurement; one sub-metric per flag: used_fence, dropped_leading_lines > 0, dropped_trailing_lines > 0, dropped_duplicated_prompt_lines > 0, relocated_includes non-empty, auto_closed, signature_suspect, braces_balanced == false; 'any' = union of the flags except used_fence (markdown fences are formatting, not code changes) and 'any_including_fence'
metrics.missingness: a missing cleaning block fails closed
metrics.limits: auto_closed means the PIPELINE closed braces - an intervention on the measured object; read next to every pass rate (sensitivity SA2)

metrics.name: build_success
metrics.meaning: the correctness-stage build compiled
metrics.missingness: every study artifact has a correctness record (verified); a missing one fails closed
metrics.aggregation: count ratio; CI by benchmark-cluster bootstrap
metrics.limits: pipeline build with the frozen compiler; not a statement about other toolchains

metrics.name: correctness_pass
metrics.meaning: the artifact passes the ParEval correctness tests (PRIMARY ENDPOINT)
metrics.denominator: artifacts with a correctness verdict other than baseline_incompatible
metrics.missingness: fail closed; baseline_incompatible excluded and reported
metrics.aggregation: count ratio; CI by benchmark-cluster bootstrap
metrics.limits: one deterministic input draw per benchmark (unseeded rand); dense_la/00 carries the BL-01 tolerance disclosure (sensitivity SA1)

metrics.name: correctness_pass_given_build
metrics.meaning: pass rate among built artifacts
metrics.limits: conditional - its denominator differs between populations

metrics.name: correctness_verdict_distribution
metrics.meaning: distribution of the verdict vocabulary

metrics.name: correctness_pass_raw_clean
metrics.meaning: proxy for unchanged raw-answer quality: pass rate among artifacts without any cleaning intervention (Q04 any_including_fence == false)
metrics.limits: selected subset (models that format cleanly are over-represented); descriptive

metrics.name: correctness_pass_excluding_auto_closed
metrics.meaning: pass rate after removing artifacts whose braces the pipeline auto-closed (sensitivity SA2)
metrics.limits: sensitivity analysis

metrics.name: enhanced_pair_pass
metrics.population: ENH_PAIRS of BASE / STEP / FINAL / GENERATED
metrics.meaning: end-to-end held-out pass rate over valid pairs
metrics.missingness: every artifact carries exactly its expected pair set (verified 109,200/109,200); a missing pair fails closed
metrics.aggregation: ratio of sums (pairs are not independent); CI by benchmark-cluster bootstrap
metrics.limits: 20 specs per artifact; specs are benchmark-specific

metrics.name: enhanced_all_pass
metrics.meaning: the artifact passes every valid held-out spec (KEY SECONDARY ENDPOINT)
metrics.numerator: artifacts with >= 1 valid pair and every valid pair pass
metrics.applicability: artifacts with >= 1 valid pair (artifacts without any valid pair are counted separately)
metrics.aggregation: count ratio; CI by benchmark-cluster bootstrap
metrics.limits: strict endpoint

metrics.name: enhanced_status_distribution
metrics.meaning: distribution of pass, fail, build_failed, crash, timeout, runtime_error and the gated statuses
metrics.limits: pairs are clustered

metrics.name: enhanced_gated_share
metrics.meaning: share of oracle-side gated pairs (baseline_incompatible, numerically_unstable)
metrics.aggregation: count ratio; also gated (benchmark, spec, execution_model) groups
metrics.limits: an oracle property, never a model failure

metrics.name: enhanced_all_pass_given_correctness_pass
metrics.meaning: held-out robustness of artifacts that pass the known tests
metrics.limits: conditional on Q06

metrics.name: static_tool_state_distribution
metrics.meaning: analysis states of each static tool (compiler, gcc_analyzer, clang_tidy, cppcheck, infer, parcoach, llov)
metrics.applicability: all; NOT_APPLICABLE and ABSENT_INAPPLICABLE shown separately
metrics.missingness: an absent entry for an applicable tool fails closed
metrics.limits: COMPLETED does not imply defect-free code

metrics.name: static_definitive_coverage
metrics.meaning: share of applicable artifacts whose analysis is COMPLETED
metrics.denominator: artifacts to which the tool applies

metrics.name: static_analysis_complete
metrics.meaning: every applicable static analysis tool (excluding the compiler) COMPLETED
metrics.numerator: artifacts with all applicable tools COMPLETED

metrics.name: dynamic_tool_state_distribution
metrics.meaning: analysis states of asan_ubsan, tsan, memcheck, must
metrics.limits: dynamic tools observe only the ParEval inputs

metrics.name: dynamic_definitive_coverage
metrics.meaning: COMPLETED among applicable

metrics.name: dynamic_analysis_complete
metrics.meaning: every applicable dynamic tool COMPLETED

metrics.name: static_verdict_three_state
metrics.meaning: DIRTY / CLEAN_COMPLETE / NO_FINDING_INCOMPLETE over the static analysis tools (finding_rules.analysis_verdict_three_state)
metrics.aggregation: counts and shares; DIRTY share with CI
metrics.limits: a union over tools of different precision; low-confidence findings excluded

metrics.name: dynamic_verdict_three_state
metrics.meaning: as F01 over the dynamic tools
metrics.limits: ParEval inputs only

metrics.name: compile_error_any
metrics.meaning: the compiler tool reported a blocking compile error

metrics.name: low_confidence_any
metrics.meaning: >= 1 low-confidence finding (any tool)
metrics.limits: low precision by validation (parcoach, MPI-Checker)

metrics.name: findings_by_tool_family
metrics.meaning: recorded findings per tool x family x kind (reported_blocking, low_confidence, non_blocking)
metrics.denominator: - (counts); additionally artifacts with >= 1 finding of the family per tool
metrics.aggregation: counts per tool (never summed across tools)
metrics.limits: counts depend on tool coverage (S02)

metrics.name: tool_agreement
metrics.meaning: agreement of two tools on the presence of a reported blocking finding of one family class on artifacts where BOTH tools COMPLETED; predefined pairs: (tsan, llov) race on omp; (must, parcoach) mpi_usage/deadlock on mpi; (asan_ubsan, memcheck) memory on all; (gcc_analyzer, cppcheck) memory+null_deref+uninitialized on all
metrics.missingness: pairs without overlap are reported as not estimable
metrics.aggregation: 2x2 counts, positive agreement, Cohen's kappa (descriptive, no test)
metrics.limits: low-confidence findings excluded; tools differ in precision and scope

metrics.name: repair_transition
metrics.population: BASE paired with STEP[v][k] and FINAL[v]
metrics.meaning: per endpoint X in {Q06 correctness_pass, E02 enhanced_all_pass, F01 static three-state, F02 dynamic three-state}: transition of the SAME base cell from BASE to STEP/FINAL
metrics.denominator: base cells (E02: cells with >= 1 valid pair; identical for base and final because gates are spec-level)

metrics.name: repair_success_rate
metrics.meaning: a SUCCESSFUL REPAIR is an improvement on an explicit endpoint for the same base cell: base not pass -> final pass (Q06), resp. base not all-pass -> final all-pass (E02)
metrics.denominator: cells failing the endpoint at baseline
metrics.aggregation: count ratio; CI by benchmark-cluster bootstrap
metrics.limits: conditional on the baseline failure set, which differs between models; terminal statuses play no role

metrics.name: regression_rate
metrics.meaning: base pass -> final not pass on the endpoint
metrics.denominator: cells passing the endpoint at baseline
metrics.limits: trajectories that never left iteration 0 cannot regress

metrics.name: net_gain
metrics.meaning: rate(FINAL[v]) - rate(BASE) on the identical cohort (= (improved - regressed) / cells)
metrics.aggregation: paired difference; CI by benchmark-cluster bootstrap; PRIMARY FAMILY

metrics.name: variant_difference
metrics.population: FINAL[v1] vs FINAL[v2] paired by base cell
metrics.meaning: rate(FINAL[v1]) - rate(FINAL[v2]) on the identical cohort
metrics.aggregation: paired difference; CI by benchmark-cluster bootstrap; PRIMARY FAMILY
metrics.limits: variants differ in loop length as well as in feedback content

metrics.name: stop_status_distribution
metrics.meaning: terminal status x final iteration per variant
metrics.limits: descriptive - stop statuses are NOT success metrics

metrics.name: budget_exhaustion_rate
metrics.meaning: the loop used the whole iteration budget (stopped_budget)

metrics.name: analysis_incomplete_stop_rate
metrics.meaning: the loop stopped because analyses were incomplete (non-model terminal status)
metrics.limits: not a model outcome

metrics.name: repaired_share
metrics.meaning: trajectories that requested at least one repair (final_iteration >= 1)

metrics.name: iterations_used
metrics.meaning: mean final_iteration
metrics.limits: bounded by 2

metrics.name: repair_requests
metrics.meaning: repair generation records (one per candidate) and request rounds (request_rounds.json)
metrics.denominator: - (counts); per trajectory and per improved cell
metrics.missingness: a missing generation record fails closed
metrics.limits: rounds include provider retries

metrics.name: tokens
metrics.meaning: provider-normalized input, output and reasoning tokens (usage_normalized)
metrics.denominator: generations (per-request means); reasoning tokens only over generations where the provider reports the field
metrics.missingness: reasoning_tokens null = provider reports no field (distinct from 0); coverage reported
metrics.limits: providers count tokens differently; reasoning settings differ per model (disclosure)

metrics.name: repair_latency
metrics.meaning: direct-mode request wall time (status.duration_seconds, timing_mode direct)
metrics.applicability: timing_mode == direct only; batch spans are queue time and are never used
metrics.limits: network and provider load; spread over days

metrics.name: tool_runtime
metrics.meaning: per tool duration_seconds
metrics.denominator: tool entries with a numeric duration, excluding TIMEOUT entries
metrics.missingness: TIMEOUT entries reported as their own share (their duration is the limit)
metrics.aggregation: median and p95 per tool x execution model; reported WITH and WITHOUT entries above the 3,600 s reporting threshold (the documented Infer outlier); raw data unchanged, no standby estimate subtracted
metrics.limits: wall-clock, host-dependent

metrics.name: gain_per_effort
metrics.meaning: improved cells (R02 numerator, Q06) per 1,000,000 repair output tokens and per 100 repair requests
metrics.denominator: repair output tokens / requests of the variant
metrics.limits: descriptive only; no ranking

metrics.name: heldout_robustness_of_repairs
metrics.population: base cells improved on Q06 under variant v
metrics.meaning: share of correctness-repaired cells whose final artifact is enhanced all-pass, compared with the enhanced all-pass share of cells that passed at baseline (E05 BASE)
metrics.numerator: improved cells with final E02 all-pass
metrics.aggregation: count ratio; difference to the baseline-pass reference with CI
metrics.limits: small denominators per model; descriptive per model

metrics.name: trajectory_parEval_vs_heldout
metrics.meaning: Q06 and E02/E01 over steps per variant (overfitting check, goal G3)

sensitivity_analyses.name: exclude_dense_la_00
sensitivity_analyses.rule: repeat Q06/R02/R04/R05 without benchmark dense_la/00_dense_la_lu_decomp (BL-01 tolerance disclosure)

sensitivity_analyses.name: exclude_auto_closed
sensitivity_analyses.rule: Q10: repeat Q06 without artifacts whose braces the pipeline auto-closed

sensitivity_analyses.name: per_block
sensitivity_analyses.rule: every headline estimate per block (pilot, full_ext) next to the composite

sensitivity_analyses.name: runtime_outlier
sensitivity_analyses.rule: C04 with and without tool entries above 3,600 s

statistics.inference_unit: benchmark (cluster): all artifacts, pairs, models, execution models, variants and iterations of one benchmark are resampled together

bootstrap.stratified_by: block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full_ext among its 48)
bootstrap.rng: Python random.Random(seed); one shared set of replicate weights per (seed, replicates) so paired estimates share resamples

statistics.point_estimates: ratio of sums over the observation units of the population (not means of per-benchmark rates)
statistics.paired_differences: computed per base cell and aggregated as ratio of sums; bootstrap over benchmarks keeps the pairing

tests.primary_family: R04 net_gain (3 variants) and R05 variant_difference (3 pairs) for the endpoints Q06 and E02 on the composite cohort: 12 hypotheses H0: difference = 0
tests.p_values: two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 * min(share of replicate differences <= 0, share >= 0)) with replicates_primary
tests.multiplicity: Holm step-down at alpha 0.05 over the 12 primary hypotheses
tests.everything_else: descriptive estimates with unadjusted 95% CIs, labelled as such; no further tests

statistics.small_cluster_warning: pilot block has 12 clusters: percentile intervals are approximate; flagged in every pilot table
not_done: no tests treating the 109,200 enhanced pairs or the 5,460 artifacts as independent

reporting.pilot_label: pilot_002 / Pilotexperiment (12 benchmarks x 3 execution models x 11 models, 1 sample per prompt)
